mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 5% YoY signals inflationary pressures that lead to tighter monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 5% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases > 0.5% in 1 month and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months indicates weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 2% in one month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO drops > 2% in 1 month and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 in one month signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases > 300,000 in 1 month and 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 10% YoY and GDP (GDPC1) grows by more than 2% YoY, it signals strong economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 10% YoY and GDPC1 > 2% YoY
failure_condition: If HOUST increases > 10% YoY and GDPC1 > 2% YoY and 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, if the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increases by more than 0.5% in one month, it signals a restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS increases > 0.5% in 1 month during a tightening cycle and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the triggered instances.
